current_projected.description: Exchange of Hologic, Inc. common stock (HOLX) for undetermined amount of non-tradable contingent value right (CVR) to be paid in 2026-27.
Cash-out payment due to privatization of Hologic, Inc. A non-tradable contingent value right of an undetermined amount is still held within the now-private company.
